# Jaya Jaya Sankara

> A mandapam named for Sri Chandrasekara Swamigal, renovated in 2020 for today's weddings.

Website: https://jayajayasankaramarriagehall.in/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 93459 85917

## Contact

## Key facts
- 15 years since it was founded
- renovated with modern comforts 2020
- 11 km from Chennai Airport
- 3 km from Nanganallur Metro

## Facilities
- Fully air-conditioned
- Bride & groom suite
- Sound & lighting
- Power backup
- A/V equipped
- Valet parking
- Car park
- Fire safety
- Security

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Jaya Jaya Sankara?
No. 10th Cross Street, Periyar Nagar, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091 (Near Gunalamman Temple and Madipakkam Bus Depot).

### What facilities does Jaya Jaya Sankara have?
Fully air-conditioned, Bride & groom suite, Sound & lighting, Power backup, A/V equipped, Valet parking, Car park, Fire safety, Security.

### Is the hall air-conditioned?
Yes, the hall is fully air-conditioned, with power backup.

### How far is it from the airport?
About 11–12 km from Chennai International Airport and 3–4 km from Nanganallur Metro.

### How do I check if Jaya Jaya Sankara is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 93459 85917.
